ready:
Get ready to spin, spin, spin the Wheel of Fortune — your gateway to thrilling surprises and incredible rewards! 
 Each spin gives you a chance to win real cash, crypto prizes, boosters, free spins, buddy balls, and exclusive rewards — even up to an iPhone.
 Feel the rush as the wheel turns and fortune finds its next winner.
rewards:
All cash and crypto rewards from the Wheel of Fortune are credited directly to the corresponding account balance. For example, if you win ETH, the reward will be added to your ETH wallet balance automatically. 
 For physical rewards or luxury items, our Customer Service team will personally contact you to coordinate delivery.
